title: Exposing and Mitigating Calibration Biases and Demographic Unfairness in MLLM Few-Shot In-Context Learning for Medical Image Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Confidence Calibration Error Gap (CCEG), mean Equalized Odds Ratio (EOR), and Equity-Scaling measure of Calibration Error (ESCE) between male and female patient groups during few-shot in-context learning for medical image classification.
Measuring the disparity in confidence calibration (CCEG), prediction fairness (EOR), and overall equity-scaled calibration (ESCE) between young (under 60) and elder (60 and older) patient groups.
Assessing calibration fairness metrics, specifically the Confidence Calibration Error Gap (CCEG), across subgroups formed by the intersection of both sex and age attributes.
